items.title: Emerging team earn hard-fought draw against South Africa
items.summary: Resuming their second innings at 15-0 and needing 396 more runs to win on the final day, Bangladesh were in deep trouble after losing five wickets for just 70 runs. However, Ankon and Biplob steadied the innings with a 105-run partnership for the sixth wicket.

items.title: Disillusionment at hand in Mackay
items.summary: The last time Bangladesh came close to following up a landmark away victory with a series win in a SENA country was in 2021/22, when they famously beat New Zealand in Mount Maunganui. An innings-and-117-run defeat in Christchurch followed inside three days. For many, it was simply Bangladesh reverting to type after producing something spectacular.

items.title: ‘We were comparing it to Argentina’s World Cup games’: Simmons on Bangladesh’s Australia Test triumph
